request: Zeig mir meine Abokosten 2025 pro Anbieter als Balken.

plan.title: Abokosten pro Anbieter
plan.question: Ausgaben der Kategorie Subscriptions 2025 je Anbieter, eine Zeile pro Anbieter, absteigend sortiert, Spalten merchant und total_eur.

sql:
SELECT coalesce(title, counterparty, description) AS merchant, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0 AND category IN ('Streaming', 'Music', 'Software')
GROUP BY merchant
ORDER BY total_eur DESC
reasoning_plan:
die Anfrage ist deutsch, also ist die Sprache de
eine Zahl je Anbieter, keine zweite Dimension
ein Balken pro Anbieter liest sich am direktesten
die Spalten sind merchant und total_eur
der Zeitraum ist das Jahr 2025
reasoning_code:
the shape is bar, so the mark is barY
the columns are merchant and total_eur, and total_eur holds the numbers
names on x on a band scale, no label dropped, tilted once they are many or long
a bar rests on zero, so its euro axis is the bare scaleLinear factory

request: Which payments come off my account every single month? Show a ranking.

plan.title: Payments made in every month
plan.question: Merchants charged in every one of the twelve months of 2025 with exactly one booking per month, their total spending, ordered by the figure, columns merchant and total_eur.

sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN lower(description) LIKE '%miete%' THEN 'Rent'
            WHEN lower(description) LIKE '%versicherung%' THEN 'Insurance'
            ELSE 'Other' END AS merchant,
       ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0
GROUP BY merchant
ORDER BY total_eur DESC
reasoning_plan:

one figure per merchant, ordered, which is a ranking
the names are long, so the bars lie sideways
the columns are merchant and total_eur
the period is the whole year 2025
reasoning_code:

the columns are merchant and total_eur, and total_eur holds the numbers
barX draws sideways, so the euro column is x and the names are y
scales.x is therefore the euro axis and scales.y the band of names, none dropped

request: Which of our fixed cost categories moved between last month and this month? Draw the two months side by side.

plan.title: Fixed costs, this month against last
plan.question: Spending on the fixed costs in December 2025 and in November 2025, one row per category and period, the period named 'This month' or 'Last month', columns topic, period and total_eur.

sql:
WITH fixed AS (
  SELECT booked_on, amount, coalesce(category, 'Needs review') AS topic
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0
    AND (lower(coalesce(title, counterparty, description)) LIKE '%wohnungsgenossenschaft%'
         OR lower(coalesce(title, counterparty, description)) LIKE '%elternbeitrag%'
         OR category IN ('Housing', 'Insurance', 'Subscriptions', 'Communication'))
)
SELECT topic, 'This month' AS period, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM fixed
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) = '2025-12'
GROUP BY topic
ORDER BY topic
reasoning_plan:
the request is written in English, so language en
two periods compared by category are two dimensions that cross
grouped bars put this month beside last month for each category
the period is the series and the category is the position
the columns are topic, period and total_eur, the euro figure last
reasoning_code:
the shape is bar_grouped, so barY carries a series and layout: group()
the columns are topic, period and total_eur, and total_eur holds the numbers
period is the series, so it is the z and the color channel and it needs a legend
the topic names on x on a band scale, tilted and none dropped, euros on y from the bare factory

request: Show how the fixed costs on our joint account added up over 2025.

plan.title: Joint account fixed costs so far
plan.question: The running total of the fixed costs booked on the joint account per month of 2025, one row per month with the cumulative figure, columns month as 'YYYY-MM' and cumulative_eur.

sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, SUM(-amount) AS spent
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0 AND (lower(coalesce(title, counterparty, description)) LIKE '%immobilien schmid%'
         OR category IN ('Housing', 'Insurance', 'Subscriptions', 'Communication')) AND account = 'Sparkasse Stuttgart Gemeinschaftskonto'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, ROUND(SUM(spent) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_eur
FROM months
ORDER BY month
reasoning_plan:
the request is written in English, so language en
'added up' is a running total over the months
an area under the running line shows the pace of it
the household has two accounts and the request names the joint one
the columns are month and cumulative_eur
reasoning_code:
the shape is area, so areaY draws the band and lineY its edge
the columns are month and cumulative_eur, and cumulative_eur holds the numbers
months on x with monthShort, euros on y
the euro axis is left without its grid
